02 // MOTION ENGINE

Steady when you stop.
Fast when you move.

Adaptive smoothing filters tiny landmark changes while keeping large movements responsive. Pinch distance is normalized to your hand size, so gestures remain consistent when you move closer to the camera.

RAW HAND SIGNALSTABILIZED OUTPUT

Air Pointer processes the webcam feed locally. The app does not upload, store or transmit your camera video.
